stories.title: CFP supports prohibiting player return from NFL
stories.summary: Leaders of the CFP stopped short of implementing any new rules around eligibility or participation but issued a statement that "strongly supports" the recent positions of conferences prohibiting players returning to college teams from the NFL.

stories.title: Sky owner calls Kanter Freedom lawsuit 'meritless'
stories.summary: Chicago Sky owner Michael Alter called a lawsuit filed by Enes Kanter Freedom "meritless and frivolous" Friday afternoon.

stories.title: Engelbert, who helped transform WNBA, to retire
stories.summary: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert, who oversaw massive growth in the league while also facing recent scrutiny in her handling of multiple issues, will retire at the end of the year.
